name: agentx
description: Get your agent's real runs into AgentX, then turn what they measure into a code fix. /agentx-init sets up a Python agent and proves it with traces it reads back; /eval-fix triages an evaluation against the source and re-runs it on the same dataset.

interface.shortDescription: Set a Python agent up on AgentX, then fix it from its evaluation
interface.longDescription: Two skills that share one loop. /agentx-init sets a Python agent up on AgentX - it reads the project key off the engine, writes .env.agentx, initialises the SDK, and puts one span where the run begins rather than a decorator on every function. It does not stop at the diff: it sends three traces and fetches each back, then grades the agent's own run for readable input and output, token counts, tool calls and session grouping, because trace delivery is fire-and-forget and a misconfigured SDK never raises. /eval-fix takes an evaluation id, triages every judge recommendation against the real source, applies what survives on a branch, and re-runs against the same dataset so the two scores mean something next to each other.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentX to set up tracing for this agent.
Use AgentX to triage evaluation <id> and fix the code.
